name: yreview
description: Comment on any line as in a pull request review, then send the comments to Claude Code, Codex or another AI agent to fix. Comments live in git notes: no server, no account.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Yreview runs git, and git reads the repository configuration, which can name programs.

colors.description: Background of the lines that an open review comment covers.
Background of the text that two or more open review comments cover.
Outline of the text that two or more open review comments cover. The high contrast themes use it in place of a background.
Background of the lines that stand where an outdated review comment was. The commented lines changed after the comment.

enumDescriptions: A new comment goes to refs/notes/y-review/local and stays on this machine.
A new comment goes to refs/notes/devtools/discuss and the extension pushes it to the remote.
yreview.newComments.markdownDescription: The button that the comment box shows first. Both buttons stay available.

yreview.remote.markdownDescription: The git remote that gets the shared comments. It must be the name of a remote of the repository.

yreview.writeRefspec.markdownDescription: After a share, ask before the extension adds `refs/notes/devtools/*:refs/notes/devtools/*` to `remote.<name>.fetch`. With this box clear, the extension does not ask, and you add the line by hand.

yreview.editorMarks.markdownDescription: Show the comment threads open and color the lines that an open comment covers.

yreview.channel.markdownDescription: Open the review bridge on the loopback address, so an agent session takes the tasks live and the review tools work. With this box clear, a send writes the review files and copies the prompt.

yreview.intellijKey.markdownDescription: Also bind Ctrl+Shift+G, the key of the IntelliJ plugin, to Add Review Comment while an editor has focus. It replaces Show Source Control there.

yreview.todoPatterns.markdownDescription: The TODO patterns of the task views. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression, and the TODO text is the part of the line that it matches, up to the end of the comment. Each pattern needs a word of two or more letters or digits outside every group, for example `\btodo\b.*`. Yreview reads the text of the files, so a TODO in a string also shows.

yreview.todoFilters.markdownDescription: Named sets of TODO patterns. The Filter button of a task view offers each set. Each entry of `patterns` is a `pattern` value of `yreview.todoPatterns`.

yreview.agent.markdownDescription: The command line agent of the review sessions. A repository cannot set this value. [Choose Agent](command:yreview.chooseAgent) shows the agents that this machine has, and what each one supports.

yreview.agentCommands.markdownDescription: The command of each agent and its arguments, by agent id, for example `{ "claude": "claude --model opus" }`. Blanks divide the words, and quotes group a word that holds a space, for example `"C:/Program Files/Agent/agent.exe" --flag`. A value that is the path of one existing file is one word. Yreview adds its own flags after these words. An agent without a value runs its default command. A repository cannot set this value.

yreview.autoStartSession.markdownDescription: Start a review session when the **Yreview Session** panel opens and an agent is chosen.

enumDescriptions: The terminal of a session opens in the panel.
The terminal of a session opens as an editor tab.
yreview.sessionLocation.markdownDescription: Where the terminal of a new review session opens.

languageModelTools.name: review_list_comments
languageModelTools.userDescription: Lists the review comments of this project.
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Lists the review comments of this project.
A person writes these comments in VS Code to ask for a change in the code.
Read them first, then do what each comment asks.
The answer is a JSON object with one "comments" array. Each item holds these fields:
- "id", the value the other review tools need
- "path", the file inside its git repository or inside its folder store
- "startLine" and "endLine", one based line numbers. 0 means the whole file
- "startColumn" and "endColumn", zero based character positions in a line. A comment
  holds them only when it covers a part of a line. "endColumn" names the character
  after the last character of the comment
- "revision", the git commit that the comment belongs to, or "worktree" for a comment
  of a folder that no git repository holds
- "author", "text", "shared" and "resolved"

resolved.description: Pass true to list the comments a person marked as resolved. The default lists the open comments.

includeAnalyses.description: Pass true to also list the comments a machine wrote.

includeLocal.description: Pass false to leave out the private comments that stay on this computer.

languageModelTools.name: review_resolve_comment
languageModelTools.userDescription: Marks one review comment as resolved.
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Marks one review comment as resolved.
Call this after you made the change the comment asks for.
The comment stays in the store as history. The answer is a JSON object with the id
and "resolved": true, or an "error" field when the id is unknown.

id.description: The id of the comment. Use a value from review_list_comments.

languageModelTools.name: review_add_comment
languageModelTools.userDescription: Writes a new review comment on a range of lines, so a person reads it later.
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Writes a new review comment on a range of lines, so a person reads it later.
Use this to record a finding you do not want to fix yourself.
Yreview anchors the comment to the current commit of the file. A file that no git
repository holds keeps its comments in a folder store, and there the revision is "worktree".
The answer is a JSON object with the new "id", or an "error" field.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the root of the project. The tool refuses a path outside the project.

startLine.description: First line of the comment. Line numbers start at 1.

endLine.description: Last line of the comment. Pass the same value as startLine for one line.

text.description: The comment text a person reads.

languageModelTools.name: review_open_comment
languageModelTools.userDescription: Shows one review comment to the person at VS Code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Shows one review comment to the person at VS Code.
VS Code opens the file at that line. When the comment belongs to an older commit,
VS Code opens the diff between that commit and the working tree instead.
Call this when you want the person to look at the code you discuss.
The answer names what VS Code opened, "file" or "diff", or holds an "error" field.

id.description: The id of the comment. Use a value from review_list_comments.
